note: Skill points in FC Mobile: you earn 1 per rank up (max 5 per player per position). A point raises position-specific SKILLS, which in turn raise the ATTRIBUTES (minor stats) that make up the six main stats. Per the public 2026 skill-point guides, the boost scales with a player's BASE OVR - so a skill point is worth much more on a high-rated card. The app models this by raising the single main stat that is most important for the player's position (and for their PlayStyles) by the OVR-scaled amount below. See rules/attributes.json for which attributes roll into each main stat and which matter per position.

ovr_scaled_gain.note: Main-stat gain from spending one skill point, by the player's base OVR band. 'normal' = a normal skill (up to level 3); 'advanced' = an advanced skill (unlocked after a normal skill hits level 3). The app uses 'normal' for its recommendations.

position_priority.note: For each position, the main stats to invest skill points in, most important first. Derived from the key attributes for that position (see attributes.json). A player's PlayStyle-boosted stats are prioritised ABOVE this list by the planner.
